name: Barbecue Pinto Bean-Zucchini Tacos with Romaine, Pepper & Ranch Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice zucchini. Set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse the beans in a colander.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini, beans, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the lettuce, along with dressing, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
When the zucchini and beans are done, add barbecue sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Divide tortillas between plates and fill with bean mixture, cheese, and a small portion of the salad. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
